title: Puerto Rico Lion:
title_q: “Good Friends and Family in the Club”
title_short: Puerto Rico Lion · Friends and Family in the Club
headline: A Puerto Rico Lion says his club friends are the reason he is stepping up to lead.
story: Eduardo, a Lion from Puerto Rico in a Lions jersey and yellow glasses, is happy because he gets to share and meet new people. Then Atdhe asks if anyone in his club is like family. His answer: of course. His friends in the club always support him in leadership, and that is why he is here as a Lion governor for the new year.
That is his own story: friendship that lifts someone into leadership. The last quarter ties back with his line “we are family”. Warm, proud, friendly. Spoken in Spanish with English subtitles.

transcript:
Transcripts (English version from the doc) of IMG_7866.MOV, IMG_7868.MOV and IMG_7867.MOV (Puerto Rico Lion, Hong Kong Convention). He speaks Spanish. Times are mm:ss in each source file. Speaker labels are automatic and often wrong.
IMG_7866.MOV
[00:00] Are you happy?
[00:02] I am happy.
[00:02] Why? What makes you happy?
[00:04] It makes my life happy, it makes my service happy, it makes me happy to share with other people and meet new people.
[00:17] Can you give a message to everyone, a piece of advice to everyone?
[00:22] I advise everyone to be supportive, to be human, to be capable, to be part of our organization, where there is a need there is a Deon, so it's important.
[00:35] It's my first time at the convention. Do you have any advice for a person who is the first time at the convention?
[00:50] For those conventionists who are the first time, enjoy all the experiences that go through each and every one of the exhibitors, the workshops, and take the most advantage of exchanging knowledge with other colleagues from different countries.
[01:06] Why did you become a lion?
[01:13] I am a lion because I like the service, because I like to help others. We are part of that civic generation that likes to serve the needy.
[01:23] Do you have a friend in your club who is like a family? Tell me about him or her.
[01:32] Well, of course, I have good friends and family in the club. Thanks to each one of them who are always supporting me in matters of leadership and that is why we are here as a lion governor for the new year.
[01:43] So, thanks to the Leonete Cabo Club and District 51 in Puerto Rico.
IMG_7868.MOV
[00:00] I have a mission. My mission is to make 365 friends in 365 days.
[00:14] Ok. Well, that's new.
[00:16] Really?
[00:17] Yes.
[00:18] Oh, nice to meet you. Thank you. Do you think it's possible with Lions?
[00:23] Yes, very possible. Very possible.
[00:25] And why Lions is good for friendship and friends?
[00:32] We are family and if we like the service to everyone, that makes us family.
[00:36] Once we are aligned with the service to the one who needs it the most, that makes us family.
[00:42] Thank you very much.
[00:43] My pleasure.
IMG_7867.MOV
[00:00] Hi, I'm Eduardo Miguel Morales and I'm a Lion from 51st Street in Puerto Rico.
